title: RetroArch PS5
description:
RetroArch PS5 — multi-system emulator + EmulationStation.

INSTALL
1. PPSA99169/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99169/
2. Load jailbreak + ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4+.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Choose RetroArch or EmulationStation; Square remembers.
• WebUI: http://YOUR-PS5-IP:6769
• Games: PPSA99169/content/ or add through WebUI.
• BIOS: PPSA99169/system/ (system-dependent).

IF IT WON'T START
• Check title folder/eboot.bin and ShadowMount+.
• Hold L1 at startup to choose the frontend again.
• No desktop RetroArch cores; use included PS5 cores.
install_note: Extract the complete PPSA99169/ title folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA99169/ (eboot.bin and sce_sys directly inside). Requires working jailbreak/homebrew environment and ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or later (especially for USB and extended storage). Launch from home screen and choose RetroArch or EmulationStation; Square remembers the choice; L1 held at startup returns to picker. WebUI from device on same LAN: http://<PS5-IP>:6769. Games can be uploaded using WebUI or placed in PPSA99169/content/<system>/; BIOS belongs to PPSA99169/system/ or system-specific subfolders. Back up savefiles/savestates before replacing the app folder. Only developer-provided native PS5 cores are compatible. No games or firmware included.

title: Castation (Dreamcast)
description:
Castation v0.4.0 — Dreamcast emulator (Flycast).

MANUAL INSTALL — HOMEBREW LAUNCHER:
1. Castation/ → /data/homebrew/Castation/
2. Check Castation/eboot.elf and homebrew.js exist.
3. Open Homebrew Launcher → Castation (NOT a PS5 title).

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Games → /data/homebrew/Castation/games/
• BIOS optional → Castation/bios/; use HLE BIOS otherwise.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check eboot.elf placement and that Homebrew Launcher is running.
• If PS5 Library opens another title, launch Castation manually.
install_note: Homebrew Launcher app, not a native PS5 title. Manually extract Castation/ to /data/homebrew/Castation/ with eboot.elf and homebrew.js directly inside. Place legally obtained Dreamcast disc images in Castation/games/ and optionally a dumped Dreamcast BIOS in Castation/bios/; otherwise enable HLE BIOS in app settings BEFORE loading a game. Launch through Homebrew Launcher, NOT ShadowMount+ native-title installation. Saves/logs under /data/Castation/. PS5 Library may navigate incorrectly using the catalog title ID; always open from Homebrew Launcher. No BIOS or games supplied.

title: Porpoise (GameCube / Wii)
description:
Porpoise v3.0 — GameCube + Wii emulator (Dolphin).

INSTALL
1. PPSA99764/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99764/
2. Register with ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4+.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Games → /data/porpoise/games/ or USB.
• Load kstuff + supported jailbreak (etaHEN, etc.).
• Keep saves in /data/porpoise/ when updating.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check ShadowMount+ version, folder and eboot.bin.
• Can't access /data? Check etaHEN Legacy Command Server.
• Use FTP binary transfers when copying files.
install_note: Unpack the Porpoise ZIP and copy the whole PPSA99764 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA99764/. Use FTP in binary transfer mode or PS5 Upload to prevent corrupting text files. Register the title with ShadowMountPlus 1.7 beta 4 or newer; requires jailbroken PS5, kstuff and supported HEN. On first launch it creates /data/porpoise/games/; put your own GameCube/Wii backups there or add locations/USB. Saves and settings remain under /data/porpoise/; preserve them when updating. If it cannot access /data under etaHEN, enable Legacy Command Server in etaHEN Toolbox. If launch immediately closes, check ShadowMount+ version and title folder. Optional GC IPL BIOS from your own hardware belongs in /data/porpoise/bios/.

title: PS5SX2 (PlayStation 2)
description:
PS5SX2 2.10 — PlayStation 2 emulator (PCSX2).

MANUAL INSTALL — ZIP contains TWO folders:
1. PPSA99203/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99203/
2. PCSX2/ → /data/PCSX2/ (keep existing saves)

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load kstuff → ShadowMount+ → ONE PS5SX2 helper ELF.
• Put your own PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios/.
• Put game backups in /data/PCSX2/games/.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Check folder and eboot.bin permissions (755).
• Remove PS2 discs before shutting down.
install_note: PS5 Library can download this ZIP, but it does not guarantee correct placement of BOTH top-level folders. Manually extract PPSA99203/ into /data/homebrew/PPSA99203/ and PCSX2/ into /data/PCSX2/; do not nest the folders or overwrite existing PCSX2 save data. BIOS: /data/PCSX2/bios/ (your own legally dumped PS2 BIOS). Games: /data/PCSX2/games/. At each boot: jailbreak/kstuff -> ShadowMount+ -> ONE PS5SX2 helper (standard PS5SXHelper.elf default; no-data-mount variant needs ShadowMount+ 1.7-beta5fix1+). Restart before swapping helpers, never load both. CE-107750-0: check PPSA99203 folder and eboot.bin permissions (755 often works). Remove PS2 DVDs before PS5 shutdown.
install_type: Manual install: two folders + helper ELF

title: PS5SX3 (PlayStation 3)
description:
PS5SX3 v7.1 — experimental PlayStation 3 emulator (RPCS3).

INSTALL — .7z archive:
1. PPSA99303/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/
2. Check eboot.bin and sce_sys/ are directly inside.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load jailbreak/kstuff → ShadowMount+ → PS5SXHelper-no-data-mount.elf.
• ShadowMount+ must provide /data; this helper does not mount it.
• PS3 firmware: get PS3UPDAT.PUP from Sony; never use PS5 system update.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Set title folder and eboot.bin permissions to 755.
• Check there is no extra nested PPSA99303/ folder.

NOTE: v7.1 release mentions a PS3 update file; redistribution rights unverified. Title ID PPSA99303 may be shared with other homebrew.
install_note: Extract the full PPSA99303/ directory from PPSA99303.7z to /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/ (not a nested duplicate). Confirm /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/eboot.bin and sce_sys/ exist. Set title folder and eboot.bin executable/traverse permissions to 755 if launch fails with CE-107750-0; ensure parent/subfolders are accessible. Load jailbreak and kstuff, then compatible ShadowMount+ (responsible for mounting /data), then PS5SXHelper-no-data-mount.elf from Payload Manager. Do not load both helper variants in one session. Sony PS3 firmware is PS3UPDAT.PUP; obtain it from Sony for personal use, never install it via the PS5's system update, and don't redistribute it without permission. v7.1 release notes mention a bundled PS3 update file; contents/licensing and developer provenance are unverified. This title ID PPSA99303 may conflict with other homebrew; verify the correct tile before launching.

title: PS5X360 (Xbox 360)
description:
PS5X360 v0.6.0 — experimental Xbox 360 emulator.

INSTALL
1. PPSA50011/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA50011/
2. Register with ShadowMount+ and launch from Home.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Games: PPSA50011/assets/roms/GAME NAME/
• Keep default.xex/ISO and related game files together.
• Load compatible jailbreak, kstuff and ShadowMount+.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check title folder/eboot.bin and permissions.
• Use Settings → Refresh game list if games are missing.
• Not all Xbox 360 titles work; check compatibility.
install_note: Extract PPSA50011.zip and copy the complete PPSA50011 folder into /data/homebrew/PPSA50011/ with eboot.bin and sce_sys at the folder root; register with ShadowMountPlus. Needs jailbreak, kstuff and a working homebrew setup (developer-tested on firmware 13.60; others unverified). For game backups, create a separate subfolder per title under /data/homebrew/PPSA50011/assets/roms/ (for example Game Name/default.xex with the game's other files); use Settings > Refresh game list after copying. Preserve games, saves and logs during upgrades. Experimental Xbox 360 compatibility; no games, keys or BIOS included. See developer's docs/INSTALLATION.md for alternative game folders.

title: XPSemu (Original Xbox)
description:
XPSemu Alpha-2.1 — original Xbox emulator (xemu).

INSTALL
1. PPSA97358/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA97358/
2. Load kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + XPSemu Helper ELF.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• /data/xemu/mcpx_1.0.bin — your own MCPX ROM.
• /data/xemu/Complex_4627.bin — your own Xbox BIOS.
• Games → /data/xemu/games/ (XISO format).

IF IT WON'T START
• 'helper.elf didn't answer'? Load XPSemu helper first.
• Setup screen shows which BIOS/ROM files are missing.
install_note: Install title folder PPSA97358/ to /data/homebrew/PPSA97358/; requires ShadowMountPlus, kstuff, and separately loaded XPSemu helper ELF (in the Payload Manager feed as XPSemu Helper; downloaded file may be named xpsemu-helper.elf). Put your own hardware-dumped mcpx_1.0.bin and Complex_4627.bin in /data/xemu/ (exact filenames). XPSemu creates a blank Xbox HDD automatically if no xbox_hdd.qcow2 supplied. Place own games in /data/xemu/games/ or USB xemu/games/, as XISO .iso/.xiso (not full redump images until converted). Launch from PS5 home screen. If it closes or displays 'helper.elf didn't answer', check jailbreak/kstuff and load the matching helper. Saves/logs reside under /data/xemu/.

title: PICO-8 PS5
description:
PICO-8 PS5 v0.1.2 — fantasy-console launcher.

INSTALL
1. PPSA99808/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99808/
2. Copy licensed Linux PICO-8 files to PPSA99808/pico8/:
   pico8_dyn AND pico8.dat (both required).

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + elfldr (:9021).
• Launch PICO-8 from the PS5 home screen.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check both PICO-8 files and matching version.
• Log: /data/pico8/loader.log
• Licensed PICO-8 files are NOT in the catalog ZIP.
install_note: Extract PPSA99808.zip and copy complete PPSA99808/ to /data/homebrew/PPSA99808/. From a legitimately licensed PICO-8 Linux download, copy BOTH pico8_dyn and pico8.dat into /data/homebrew/PPSA99808/pico8/; they are not included in the launcher ZIP. Needs jailbroken PS5, kstuff, ShadowMountPlus, and elfldr running on localhost port 9021 to elevate /data access. The included sandbox-elevator.elf belongs to the app folder; no unrelated ELF needed. ShadowMount+ should add home-screen icon; launch from there. Runtime data/saves under /data/pico8/; for issues check /data/pico8/loader.log. Do not upload or distribute commercial PICO-8 binaries.

title: Ruffle Flash PS5
description:
Ruffle Flash PS5 v1.2.0 — SWF / Flash emulator.

INSTALL
1. PPSA68091/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA68091/
2. Load kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + Ruffle Helper ELF.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Put .swf games in /data/ruffle/games/.
• Keep each game's extra files in its own folder.
• Start Ruffle Flash from the PS5 home screen.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check Ruffle's matching helper is loaded.
• Check title folder/eboot.bin and ShadowMount+.
• Log: /data/ruffle/ruffle.log
install_note: Install PPSA68091/ to /data/homebrew/PPSA68091/ from developer ZIP. Load kstuff and ShadowMountPlus and the separate Ruffle matching helper (Payload Manager entry Ruffle Flash PS5 Helper, downloaded locally as ruffle-flash-helper.elf; upstream download name helper.elf) before launching. Place your own .swf files in /data/ruffle/games/; SWF titles with accompanying media/db files should have their own subfolder with the required relative files intact. Covers under /data/ruffle/covers/, saves under /data/ruffle/saves/; logs /data/ruffle/ruffle.log. Not all Flash features work, especially online-only content and some heavy ActionScript 3 titles; no games bundled.
